title: Idiom Understanding as a Tool to Measure the Dialect Gap

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the zero-shot accuracy of 111 LLMs on multiple-choice idiom understanding benchmarks for a prestige dialect (Metropolitan French) versus a regional dialect (Quebec French) using statistical significance tests (Z-tests).

Evaluating the models' ability to comprehend culturally-embedded regional phrases and terms, demonstrating that performance disparities stem from a lack of specific cultural-lexical knowledge rather than general linguistic or syntactic complexity.
